role.altitude: The specialist stops keying carrier lists and grading jobs one at a time. They own Noordhaven's job architecture, the evidence behind each pay difference ahead of the pay transparency law, and the benefits contracts. Machines do the lists, reconciliations and first drafts.
reach: People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: build the AFAS gap report and job-scheme data together, and learn the extract and Power BI model.
Payroll Specialist: share the deduction-to-carrier reconciliation, and learn how month close handles pension and insurance corrections.
HR Business Partner: use the answer desk for manager questions, and learn which questions keep coming back so policy text gets fixed.
FP&A Analyst: reuse the benefits and CAO costing model, and learn the budget cycle so options arrive in time.
skills_to_grow: Job evaluation on the four EU factors (skills, responsibilities, effort, working conditions) and explaining it to the works council
Reading and challenging model-drafted grades and answers, including AI Act oversight duties
Basic data work: AFAS extracts, Power BI, simple Python or SQL checks
Pay-gap analysis and writing defensible explanations for pay differences
role.ambitious_version: A governed job architecture in AFAS that covers every role, including agency workers' pay data, with a yearly gap report and a pay-request reply service ready well before the first report over 2027 pay is due on 7 June 2028. Benefits mutations and reconciliations run without manual lists.

tasks.short: Send benefit and pension changes to carriers, check their invoices, answer questions, renew contracts with brokers.

steps.what: Compile joiners, leavers and salary changes into carrier mutation lists
Submit mutations to pension fund, insurer and broker portals
Reconcile carrier invoices with AFAS headcount and payroll deductions
Answer employee pension and insurance questions and handle exceptions

loop.input: employee question plus retrieved pension fund and insurance documents and the employee's scheme data
loop.output: draft answer with cited document passages
loop.check: Every claim must cite a retrieved passage; specialist approves before sending; answers say they are AI-drafted (AI Act Art. 50)
loop.stop: One draft plus one retry when citations are missing; if still missing, route to specialist with no draft
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions arrive as free text and the answers sit in long fund documents; a fixed FAQ covers only part of them.

steps.what: Review contracts and renewals with brokers and carriers

tasks.design: A scheduled job on the governed data platform reads AFAS mutations, builds carrier mutation files in each carrier's format, and queues them for one-click approval. A second job matches carrier invoices to AFAS headcount and payroll deductions and shows breaks on a Power BI page. A small answer desk on SharePoint documents drafts cited replies to pension questions for the specialist to send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each carrier wants its own format and portal. The volume was too small to justify custom integration, so the Excel sheet stayed.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes small format mappers and reconciliation scripts cheap to build. Retrieval over fund documents can draft answers with citations.
tasks.still_hard: Carrier portals without an API, the pension transition at Pensioenfonds Vervoer, and exceptions such as long-term sick employees, which need judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiating with brokers and explaining pension choices to a worried employee needs trust and accountability.

ambition.what: A cited pension question service for warehouse and transport staff before and after the Pensioenfonds Vervoer transition to the new scheme on 1 January 2027.

tasks.altitude: Less list-keying, more time on carrier contracts and the pension transition. The specialist signs off submissions and exception lists instead of producing them.

reach.learn: How deduction corrections flow so reconciliation breaks are fixed at the source.
When invoices are approved so the reconciliation runs before payment.

evidence.claim: Carrier data handling suits deterministic software; pension questions suit an agent citing fund documents.
Pensioenfonds Vervoer expects its new scheme on 1 January 2027.
A benefits chatbot must tell users that it is AI.
Noordhaven's drivers are in Pensioenfonds Vervoer.

assumptions: The pension fund, insurers and broker accept file uploads or have APIs.
Benefits deductions are visible in AFAS payroll per employee.
unknowns: Which carriers and brokers Noordhaven uses, and their file formats.
Whether the warehouse CAO has its own pension scheme.
Volume of monthly mutations and employee questions.
research_questions: How many hours a month go into mutation lists and invoice checks today?
Which carriers offer an API or SFTP upload for mutations?
What share of employee pension questions can be answered from fund documents alone?
Does the works council need to be informed about an AI answer desk on pension data?

tasks.short: Evaluate a new or changed job, decide its grade, CAO status and salary band.

steps.what: Gather job facts from manager interview and existing descriptions
Write or update the job description

loop.input: structured intake form and the closest existing job descriptions
loop.output: draft job description in the house template
loop.check: Template fields complete; manager confirms content; specialist edits
loop.stop: One draft per intake; a missing field goes back to the manager as a question
loop.why_not_simpler: Intake notes are free text and every job differs; a template alone leaves the writing to the person.

steps.what: Score the job on the evaluation factors and compare with similar jobs

loop.input: job description, factor definitions (skills, responsibilities, effort, working conditions) and graded reference jobs
loop.output: per-factor score with reasons and the three nearest reference jobs
loop.check: Deterministic check that the total maps to one grade and sits within the range of similar jobs; specialist decides every grade
loop.stop: One scoring pass; disagreement with nearest jobs flags for full manual evaluation
loop.why_not_simpler: Matching free-text duties to factor levels needs reading; rules on keywords miss context.

steps.what: Set grade, CAO or non-CAO status and salary band; record in AFAS
Write the grading rationale and inform manager and HRBP

tasks.design: A Microsoft Forms or Power Apps intake feeds a bounded model step that drafts the job description and per-factor scores with reasons against Noordhaven's evaluation system and reference jobs. The specialist decides the grade in AFAS Profit job schemes, and every proposal, score and decision is logged for the pay transparency report and AI Act oversight. CAO-covered jobs stay inside the CAO grading system and are only checked, never rescored.
tasks.previous_blocker: Grading needs reading and judgement on free-text job content, and a wrong grade becomes a pay difference nobody can explain.
tasks.enabler_now: Models can draft per-factor scores with reasons that a specialist can check; a pilot reports over 70% agreement with experts. AFAS Profit 8 stores job schemes ready for pay transparency.
tasks.still_hard: About 30% of model scores will be off, so every grade needs a real review. The CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer regrading is still open, and grade recommendations may count as high-risk AI from December 2027.
tasks.human_edge: The specialist weighs the job's real content against the structure, holds the line with managers, and answers for the grade to the employee and the works council.

ambition.what: Re-check every non-CAO office job against the four-factor system once before the first pay transparency report, instead of only when a manager asks.

tasks.altitude: The specialist moves from writing and scoring to deciding and defending grades. They own the job architecture and its evidence file.

reach.task: Maintaining AFAS job schemes and the Power BI pay model
reach.learn: How job data feeds the gap report.
How to show the salary band before negotiation, as the law will require.

evidence.claim: Model grading of 50 job descriptions per HERA factor exceeded 70% agreement with experts.
AFAS Profit 8 stores job schemes and categories as preparation for pay transparency.
Pay transparency requires job evaluation on four factors with works council consent to the system.
Grade or pay recommendations can be high-risk under AI Act Annex III 4(b) from 2 December 2027, with logs and worker representatives told first.
A grading system needs works council consent unless a CAO settles it.

assumptions: Noordhaven has or will adopt a documented job evaluation system for non-CAO jobs.
Job descriptions are stored in SharePoint in a usable form.
unknowns: Which evaluation method Noordhaven uses today, if any.
How many jobs fall outside both CAOs.
Whether the works council has already consented to the current grading system.
research_questions: How often does the model's per-factor score match the specialist's on 30 past Noordhaven gradings?
How many evaluations a year are new jobs versus changed jobs?
Will the works council consent to a model-drafted scoring step with human decision?
Does the outcome of the CAO Beroepsgoederenvervoer regrading change which jobs are in scope?

tasks.short: Research benefit and health and safety practices and propose policy changes to HR leadership.

steps.what: Scan law, CAO, pension fund and market updates

loop.input: fixed list of sources: government sites, CAO parties, pension fund, chosen benchmarks
loop.output: monthly digest of changes with links and a relevance note per item
loop.check: Each item links to its source; specialist marks relevant or not
loop.stop: One pass per source per month; unreadable sources are listed, not guessed
loop.why_not_simpler: Sources are free-text pages and documents; a feed reader gives volume without relevance.

steps.what: Pull internal data on uptake, cost, absence and incidents
Compare options and cost them for Noordhaven's population
Write recommendation and present to HR Director and works council

loop.input: option costing, practice summary and the specialist's chosen option
loop.output: first draft memo in the house format
loop.check: Specialist rewrites and signs; figures pulled only from the costing file
loop.stop: One draft; no figures generated by the model
loop.why_not_simpler: The memo is prose; templates help only with structure.

tasks.design: A monthly bounded model job reads a fixed source list and writes a cited digest to SharePoint. A Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract shows benefits uptake, cost and absence by site and group. A reusable Python or Excel costing model replaces one-off spreadsheets, and a model drafts the memo from it.
tasks.previous_blocker: The research was ad hoc and the data sat in several AFAS reports, so each proposal started from scratch.
tasks.enabler_now: Cheap source monitoring with models, plus quick dashboard and costing builds through AI coding on the existing Power BI extract.
tasks.still_hard: Judging what fits a shift-based workforce and the CAO, and agreeing changes with the works council.
tasks.human_edge: Choosing what Noordhaven should offer and convincing leadership and the works council takes judgement and standing.

ambition.what: A yearly benefits review per site, with uptake and cost shown to the HR Director before the budget round.

tasks.altitude: Research time drops; more time goes to options and talks with the works council. Nothing changes in decision rights.

reach.learn: The budget calendar and assumptions so options are costed the same way.

reach.task: Absence cases under Wet verbetering poortwachter
reach.learn: Which health and safety gaps drive absence on each site.

evidence.claim: Market and policy findings suit a copilot; costing suits deterministic software.
Compa Analyst Agent with Mercer data drafts market-pricing findings.

assumptions: The nightly AFAS extract contains benefits enrolment and absence fields.
Incident data exists somewhere it can be read.
unknowns: Where health and safety incidents are recorded today.
How many policy proposals a year reach the HR Director.
research_questions: Which three past proposals took the most time, and in which step?
Is benefits uptake by site available in the AFAS extract today?
Would the HR Director use a yearly benefits review in the budget round?

tasks.short: Answer manager and employee questions on CAO, pay, benefits, procedures and grading.

steps.what: Receive and sort questions from mail, Teams and walk-ins
Look up CAO article, policy and the person's record

loop.input: question plus CAO texts, policies and contract templates indexed from SharePoint; employee fields from AFAS via lookup
loop.check: Passages must come from the current indexed version; specialist sees sources
loop.stop: Top passages once; if none score above threshold, the case goes to the specialist marked 'no source'
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions are free text and CAO wording varies; keyword search misses many matches.

loop.output: draft answer citing CAO article or policy section
loop.check: Citation required for each rule stated; specialist approves before sending; standard questions may later go out with the AI notice after a review period
loop.stop: One draft and one retry; no citation means no draft
loop.why_not_simpler: Answers combine several rules for one person's case; fixed templates cover only common questions.

steps.what: Discuss complex or sensitive cases with manager or employee

tasks.design: A shared Outlook or Teams intake creates a case in a simple list, and an answer desk indexes the CAO texts, policies and templates on SharePoint to draft cited answers. The specialist approves each draft, and repeat questions feed a FAQ page that managers can read themselves. Personal data from AFAS is only looked up for the case at hand, and access is logged under GDPR.
tasks.previous_blocker: The answers depend on two CAOs and many policies; search over SharePoint was poor, and nobody trusted an unsourced answer.
tasks.enabler_now: Retrieval with cited drafts makes answers checkable in seconds. The case list can be configured in Microsoft 365 that Noordhaven already has.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping CAO and policy versions current, cases with an individual twist, and the cost of a wrong answer on pay or dismissal rules.
tasks.human_edge: Hard or sensitive conversations, and judging when a question is really a complaint or a grading dispute.

ambition.what: Shift leaders in Tilburg and Venlo warehouses get same-day cited answers on CAO allowances and shift pay, which they now rarely ask.

tasks.altitude: Look-up time falls and the specialist spends their time on the hard cases and on fixing unclear policy text. Nothing changes in decision rights.

reach.learn: Which questions can be served from the same answer desk.
Which recurring questions signal a policy that needs rewriting.

evidence.claim: Advice and complaints suit a copilot with low autonomy; complaints stay human-led.
A chatbot answering employees must disclose that it is AI.
Pay requests must be answered within two months under the coming pay transparency law.

assumptions: CAO texts and policies are in SharePoint in readable form.
unknowns: Question volume per week and share from shift workers.
Whether the warehouse CAO text is current and complete in SharePoint.
Rules on who may see which employee data in AFAS.
research_questions: What share of last quarter's questions had a clear answer in a CAO article or policy?
How often do cited drafts need more than light edits in a four-week trial?
Would shift leaders use a Teams intake, or do they need another channel?
